question: Should OpenClaw permanently support this plugin SDK contract for external verification to authorize protected tool calls, with Gateway-owned final resolution and lifecycle state?
rationale: The branch is technically scoped around a new long-lived authorization and SDK boundary; source review cannot decide whether that capability belongs in the supported core plugin contract.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow Gateway-owned contract
options.body: Accept the proposed plugin APIs and durable attempt ledger as the supported generic seam, while keeping verifier-specific transport and policy in plugins.

options.title: Pause for a smaller contract decision
options.body: Defer merge until maintainers specify whether reusable grants and the completion API should ship together or be split into a smaller initial capability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow Gateway-owned contract
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed plugin APIs and durable attempt ledger as the supported generic seam, while keeping verifier-specific transport and policy in plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked proposal and reference integration and can clarify the intended external-verifier contract; final product acceptance remains a repository maintainer decision.
